toolsIntro: Find a tool for your task. Enabling a tool keeps your existing work.
firstHelp: A project holds your books; a book holds your records. Start with a project, create a book, then write a note.
siteScope: These settings affect this website. App appearance is saved separately on this computer in Preferences. Existing website themes are preserved.
draftHelp: A recovery checkpoint keeps your draft. Save changes updates the record; closing with a checkpoint keeps the draft for later.
noItems: No items yet. Use the create action above to get started.
readFailed: The collection could not be loaded. Retry to check its contents.
evidenceJourney: Import an original → interpret data → analyze → add a figure or result. Originals stay private; each derived result retains its source.
publishingJourney: Save design → preview draft → prepare edition → review selected content → export or publish.
publishingHelp: Available for publication means eligible for selection. Only the reviewed edition is exported; saving a record or website does not publish it.
scopeHelp: Search within the selected location. Locked or unopened locations are not searched.
keyboardSheet: Enter moves down; Shift+Enter moves up. Alt+Arrow moves between cells. Tab follows the row. Cell text and formulas are preserved.
collaborationHelp: Choose the exchange you need: request a review, share a copy, or connect for live access. Organization membership alone does not grant access to a workspace.
